text: like a few pieces of cake or a couple of .... These are minimally functional.  They are so, so thin and flimsy.  I appreciate the concept and price.  If you have something very light, like a few pieces of cake or a couple of chicken pieces, they suffice.  However, if you fill it with anything more substantial, the pans shift and make it difficult to secure the lids.  Having a heavier aluminum with a wider lip for sealing would be very helpful, but also increase the cost more.  If you are looking to send home food with minimal weight, this could be an economical solution.  If you are looking to store a good amount of leftovers or fill the pan more completely, look elsewhere.
